none: PAS NLM-52153C: Roman Coin: Denarius of Trajan
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius of Trajan (98-117), possibly mint of Rome issue of 109, Reece period 4. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [--]O AVG G[ER DA]C[--]. Reverse description: Figure wearing pileus-type hat seated left on arms. In exergue: DAC CAP. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this chipped coin citing Sear volume 2 no. 3137 (type). Diameter: 18.6mm, Weight: 2.40gms,…
